text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Good morning, everyone. 
Starting today, we will begin full-scale 
dress rehearsals."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"At 10:00, the three of you will 
coordinate the group events. 
After a lunch break, individual practice 
will start at 13:30."

text_block_list.name: All Three
text_block_list.text: Understood, thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text:
"Alright, let's start with the opening 
remarks! 
3, 2, 1...—!"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"'Delivering the charm of dirt tracks in a 
flash! I'm Copano Rickey!' 
...And now! It's finally time for the 
'Midsummer Sandy Beach Dirt Fest♪' to 
begin!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"'You bet, Rickey! 
I, Hokko Tarumae, am super-duper excited 
too~♪'"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"'Fighting spirit even in the heat!' Er, 
next is... right, my name. 
I'm Wonder Acute, y'hear~! 
Hehehe............♪"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(Acute-san is way off-script... and that 
pause was a bit long too... 
Could she have forgotten her next line? If 
so...!)

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, 'The curtain rises at last...!' 
Come, come, it's almost time for the grand 
opening~!"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Tarumae, that was Acute-san's line.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I-I know that...!"

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm, our timing isn't quite lining up... 
Maybe everyone's a bit nervous? Let's take 
it from the top one more time!"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sorry, dearie...! 
I really need to speak up more briskly."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, that was on me just now...! 
I'm so sorry. Let's do it again, please!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, in the afternoon, 
they began their individual practice for 
their main events.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: —Whoooaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: —Heeei-yah!!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Heave-ho... Diving into the sand sure 
takes some nerve, doesn't it? 
For a laid-back gal like me, it's a bit 
tough."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Still, if I train steadily, I know I can 
do it...♪ 
I won't lose to the local club's 
Umamusume~!"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Acute-san is totally fired up! 
Tarumae's giving it her all on stage 
too... All right, me too!"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"——...Gently feel the earth's qi~~~. 
——Ka! The sand sculpture that best matches 
the front of this stall is... the 
Vermilion Bird!"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Earth and Fire are mutually generating. If 
I make a firebird out of sand, its power 
will double!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Prosperous Business☆Happy Vermilion Bird 
is complete! ...Just like this, 
I'll run all around the venue creating 
Lucky☆Sand Art♪"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"And to top it off, a giant Dragon God 
right in the special art space—BAM! 
The quality will... well, it'll improve 
over time☆"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"For now, let's just make a bunch! Art is 
an explosion! 
Rickey☆ Lucky☆ Master Artist☆!"

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text:
"Haha, the beach flags and sand live art 
are coming along nicely. 
At this rate, they'll definitely be in 
great shape by festival day."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: (I'll make up for earlier... right here!)

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text:
"As expected, her singing and choreography 
are flawless! Now it's just a matter of 
how well she rides the festival 
atmosphere... that only comes with vibe 
and practice."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, but her timekeeping is wonderful. 
It's well within a 10-second margin of 
error. ...Falcon-san, you're up soon."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: "Okey-dokey! Here I go☆"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Summer festival~~~!! 
Sha-sha-sha-shaaaii!! 
Falco came running all the way to the 
sea~~☆"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"~~♪ Just keep on running~♪ With all of 
your smiles~~♪ 
It's wa~ay~ too~ ho~ot~~~♪"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Amazing...! The lyrics, the MC talk, 
packed with ad-libs... 
It feels like there's a real audience 
right in front of her.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
She looks like she's having so much fun... 
No, she's *making* it look that way. 
She's totally different from me... It's 
like she doesn't even need a script.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Wait, this is no time to be staring in 
awe! 
I've gotta get changed while I can...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
That was "Full Speed! Ahead! Umadol 
Power☆"~☆ 
Ehehe, actually~...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I changed up the lyrics a teeny-tiny bit 
for the Summer Fest version! 
Did you catch where~? Totally put you in 
that summer mood, right☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty, time to hand things back over to 
Tarumae-chan♪ 
This was your Umadol, Smart Falcon☆

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Haaaaahhh... I was completely hopeless... 
Falco-san was incredible... A total pro...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Rickey and Acute-san seemed to be doing 
great too. 
I'm sure they'll just keep getting better 
and better from here...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Pull it together, Tarumae! All you can 
do is practice! 
Even if ad-libbing isn't my strong suit, I 
just have to do it!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I have to make this a success... No matter 
what...! 
I have to do it, I have to...! 
Perfectly... Urgh――!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Taru~mae~! Ah, there you are☆ Geez, still 
doing solo practice? 
The dinner buffet's gonna end soon, you 
know~...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what's wrong?! You're sweating so 
much... Oh no! Somebody, help――!
